landing.heroTitle: One clear task at a time for your team.
landing.heroSubtitle: SirRelay keeps small groups aligned on the web and Telegram — assign work, follow progress, and send the next task when the current one is done.
landing.demoCaption: One task in focus — the next one arrives when the current one is done.
landing.featuresLead: You run the group. Everyone sees the work that matters now.

simple.title: Simple to run
simple.body: Invite members, assign tasks, and follow progress on a clean board or list. Operators see everything; teammates see only their queue.

calm.title: Only what matters now
calm.body: Tasks and due dates — that's the whole picture. No dashboards to maintain, no noise in the way of the next step.

relay.title: One task at a time
relay.body: On Telegram, linked members get a single active task. Mark it done and the next one arrives — focused relay, not overload.

what.a: A task relay for small groups — web for the full picture, Telegram for one task at a time.

groups.a: Create an account, start a group or accept an invite. Tasks and members live inside each group.

metrics.a: No. No leaderboards, velocity charts, or surveillance KPIs — just tasks, due dates, and relay.

telegram.a: Optional but useful for everyone. Linked members get one task at a time on Telegram; operators also get alert DMs. The web always shows the same state.

data.a: On SirRelay servers (PostgreSQL). Signed-in pages are never cached by the browser; the session uses one essential cookie.
